content: Hessa gishshas koyroppe Kirstoosa gishshas imettida timirteza aggidi ane gede mino timirtekko boos. Hayqqida oosoppe maaroteththan gelo gishshassinne Xoossan ammano gishshas ane izan buro wodhdhi maadhdhoko.
Hessaththoka xinqata gishshassinne kushe asa bolla wotho gishshas qasseka hayqqidayta denththaa gishshassinne mernaa pirda gishshas buro woththi doommoko.
Xoossa shene gidikko nu hessaththo ooththana.
Ba ammano kaddida asata istta maaroteththan wostti zoranee? He asati poo7oy isttas issito poo7idayta salo imoteththaa ekki be7idayta, Xillo Ayana ekki be7idayta,
Xoossaa lo7o qaalanne buro yaana alameza wolqqa ekki be7idayta,
zaari kaddidayta, istta nam7anththo zaari maaroteththan ekoy dandayettenna; gaasoykka istti ba mooros Xoossa Naa zaari kaqqeettessinne kawushsheettes.
Ubba wode ira uyiza biittaya qasseka iza goyizaades ayfe immiza biittaya Xoossa achchan anjjettadus.
Gido attiin agunththinne odoroy mokkiza biittaya go7ay bayndaaro gidana; he biittays qanggeteththi matan dees; izi wurseththi taman xuugeteth gidana.
Ta ishatoo! Nuni hessaththo haasaykkoka inttes intte atoteththara oykettida lo7o miishshi dizayssa nu sidhokko.
Kase gidiin woykko ha7i gidiinkka intte ammanizayta maaddidayssanne iza sunththaa gishshas intte bessida siiqoteththaa balanaas Xoossi makkallanchcha gidenna.
Inttes imettida hidotay polettana gakkanaas inttefe issi issi asi hessa mala ooso wurseth gakkanaas genccidi ooththana mala nu amottoos.
Ammanoninne dandayan intte iza hidota qaalaa laattizayta misatanaappe attiin dotta7ata gidanayssa nu koyokko.
Xoossi Immida Hidota Qaala Tumateth
Xoossi Abrahaames hidota immida wode caaqqishe hara izappe aadhdhizaadey baynda gishshas barkka banan, «Ta nena tumappe anjjana; tani ne zereth darsana» gi caaqqides.
Abrahaameykka gencci naagidaappe kaallidi izas imettida hidota demmides.
Asay caaqo caaqqishe baappe dhoqqan caaqqees; Caaqozikka geetettidayssi polettana mala minththiza gishshas caaqqidayta giddon palamay dendiko kase caaqo qaalay diggees.
Xoossi laamettontta ba qofaa hidota qaalaa laattanaytas qonccisana mala koyida gishshas caaqo qaalan minththides.
Xoossi ay wodekka wordotanaas dandayenna; izi laamettontta nam7u miishshatan nu sinththan diza hidotaa oykkanaas izakko shiiqida nuni gita minoteth demmana mala ooththides.
Nunikka shempo teqe gidida minonne ammanththiza hidota demmidos; he hidotaykka magalashazappe guye baggara diza gede Xoossa Keeththaa gido gelees.
He soozikka nu gishshas Yesusi kaseti gelidaso; izikka Malkexeedeqe shuumeteththaa mala mernaas qeeseta halaqa gidides.

footnotes.text: Magalasha gizayssa issi issi bagga Gamoththon qaalan magaraja geettes.
